Who We Are

Your Partner for
Integrated Construction Solutions

MaYa delivers comprehensive construction support, facilities management, and environmental services across the complete project lifecycle.

Our Expertise

MaYa Sustainable Solutions is an international consulting and services firm specializing in Construction Site Support, Facilities Management, Landscaping, Environmental Compliance, and Sustainable Solutions.

With a strong presence in Saudi Arabia and registered entities in the UK and USA, we combine local regulatory knowledge with global best practice to deliver dependable, compliant, and efficient outcomes.

Our teams bring hands-on experience supporting complex construction, infrastructure, industrial, and public-sector projects – from early-stage planning through to operations and optimization.
